data.question: How does Smart Pricing decide a nightly rate?
data.answer: Smart Pricing looks at your base rates, weekends, holidays, and how many nights are already booked in the next 30 days. It proposes a rate per night and you approve before anything changes.

data.question: Can I undo a Smart Pricing run?
data.answer: Yes. Open Pricing, pick the run under History, and choose Revert. Rates return to what they were before that run.

data.explanation: RevPAR (Revenue per Available Night) = gross lodging revenue ÷ total nights available (booked + open). Combines occupancy and rate into one number.
